svg.text: Keep one prompt, absolute positions and a coherent cursor
Constructed seven-position reference • chunks three / two / two
Prompt slices do not create output tokens
First chunk positions0–2 → committed c3
Second positions3–4 → c5; final5–6 → c7
First selection only after final prompt commit
Second chunk still reads the old prefix
Query3 sees keys0–3; query4 sees0–4
Local row zero is absolute query three
Reserved or future rows are not valid context
Logical work remains full causal work
Chunk pair counts: six + nine + thirteen
Total28 = seven × eight / two
Row three exposes descriptor defects
Correct scalar attention: 49/15
Drop prior keys:4; leak next key:129/31
Reset new key position:21/8
Every legal contiguous partition preserves the same allowed pairs; seven positions give 64 partitions.
Real kernels still need numerical/output checks; equal pair count is not equal physical time.
